question.text: What will President Lee Jae-myung's job approval rating be in Gallup Korea's weekly poll released on November 27, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the share of respondents saying President 이재명 (Lee Jae-myung) is "doing a good job" (긍정 평가 / "잘하고 있다") in the 대통령 직무 수행 평가 section of the 한국갤럽 데일리 오피니언 (Gallup Korea Daily Opinion) weekly report published on Friday, November 27, 2026 (KST), i.e. the weekly report listed with that publication date at https://www.gallup.co.kr/gallupdb/report.asp. The resolved value is the nationwide figure reported for all respondents, on Gallup Korea's published integer-percentage scale — e.g., a reported 39% resolves as 39. If Gallup Korea publishes that week's report on November 26, 2026 (KST) instead, that report is used. If no weekly 데일리 오피니언 report is published on either November 26 or November 27, 2026 (KST), the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: If Gallup Korea's website is unavailable, the figure reported for that same release by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) is used.

research:
Gallup Korea's latest report (제682호, Nov 13) puts Lee's approval at 39%, inside a 38-41% band that has held since September. Nothing has happened yet that settles the Nov 27 number.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13: Gallup's report list (report.asp) shows the newest entry as report #1667, dated 2026/11/13, which reads as 데일리 오피니언 제682호 (November week 2). The page text came back with garbled Korean characters. Only the numbers and dates were readable, so I could not confirm the 39% figure on the page itself. [Gallup](https://www.gallup.co.kr/gallupdb/report.asp)
- Reports on the list are dated 11/13, 11/06, 10/30 (#680, October week 5), 10/23 (#679) and 10/16 (#678). That fits weekly Friday releases. The Nov 27 report should be 제684호, with fieldwork Nov 24-26.
- I found no machine-readable data file behind the page.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Nov 27 fieldwork has not started.
- 2026-11-13: The question background and Maeil Business both put 제682호 (Nov 10-12, n=1,002) at 39% approval, 50% disapproval and 10% undecided. Democratic Party support was 39% and People Power Party (PPP) 26%. [MK](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/politics/12209360)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: Lee sent the Justice Minister and National Tax Service chief nominations to the National Assembly for confirmation hearings. [Korea Times](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/politics/20261116/lee-approves-confirmation-hearing-requests-for-justice-minister-tax-agency-chief-nominees)
- 2026-11-16: Realmeter for Asia Economy (Nov 9-13, n=2,512): approval 36.4% (+0.5), disapproval 60.9%. Realmeter says approval has stayed in the mid-to-high 30s since late August. In this poll the PPP leads the Democrats by 8.4 points. [MK](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/politics/12209569), [Yonhap](https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20261116017851001)
- 2026-11-15: Democratic leader Kim Min-seok reaches his 100th day on Nov 24. Party support is down 2 points since he took over, and a merger with the Cho Kuk party is being discussed. [MK](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/politics/12209360)
- 2026-11-14: On X, Lee publicly backed Deputy Speaker Chun Jun-ho amid infighting in the Democratic Party ("arrows flying from behind"). [Donga](https://www.donga.com/news/Politics/article/all/20261115/135024716/2)
- 2026-11-06: Gallup for Nov 3-5 was 41/50. Top approval reasons: diplomacy 18%, economy 15%. Top disapproval reasons: real estate 19% (the top reason since July week 4), economy 13%. By age, people in their 20s were at 28% and 30s at 32%. By region, Daegu/North Gyeongsang was at 26%. Party support: Democrats 36, PPP 28. [Weekly Khan](https://weekly.khan.co.kr/article/202611061020001)

## 4. Base rates
- Gallup weekly readings: 39 (Oct 13-15), 40, 39, 41, 39 (Nov 10-12). Mean is about 39.6, range 39-41, and week-to-week moves were 1-2 points.
- About 2026-09-11: Gallup's record low of 38% at the time, blamed on the fallout from cabinet nominations. [Weekly Khan](https://weekly.khan.co.kr/article/202609111016001)
- Earlier in the year approval was much higher: 63% in February 2026 [Daum/Newsis](https://v.daum.net/v/20260213111446622). The long decline has flattened into a 38-41% band since September.
- Seasonality: no clear seasonal pattern.
  - In 2025, Lee went from 63 to 59 between November weeks 1 and 2 on a single controversy, then held at 60 by late November. [Herald](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025111407000041984), [Herald](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025112718084448298)
  - In 2022, Yoon read 29, 30, 29 across November weeks 1-3. [Imaeil](https://www.imaeil.com/page/view/2022111811053579051)
  - Mid-to-late November moves have usually been within about ±2-4 points over two weeks.
- Over two weeks of sampling error alone (±3.1 points at 95% confidence) on a stable base, the Nov 27 value would usually land within about ±3 of 39-40.
- Realmeter runs about 3 points below Gallup approval, partly because Gallup has a 10% undecided share. Realmeter has been flat at 35.9-36.4.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on Gallup Korea approval.
- Related markets:
  - Polymarket: "Lee out as president in 2026" Yes 2.6%; "Lee arrested before 2027" Yes 2.2%.
  - Kalshi: "Lee serves full term" Yes 58%.
  - Kalshi and Polymarket both give about 98% for a 25bp Bank of Korea **hike** on Nov 25. A rate rise could feed into views on housing and the economy.
- I found no expert forecasts.
- I could not find NBS figures for November 2026. NBS normally releases on Thursdays, and its next release could be a leading input. The latest I found was July: 55%. [Segye](https://www.segye.com/newsView/20260730507745)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Nov 24-26 fieldwork)
- Nov 16-27: Budget Committee subcommittee markup of the about ₩820.9tn 2027 budget.
- Nov 19: Supreme Court full bench hears Han Duck-soo's insurrection appeal. His detention expires Nov 20. This feeds the dispute over impeaching Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae and a possible parliamentary investigation into him.
- Nov 24: Kim Min-seok's 100 days, with possible news on a merger with the Cho Kuk party.
- Nov 25: Bank of Korea decision, with a hike nearly certain according to markets.
- Ongoing: the stalled housing-supply bills, plus confirmation hearings (due within 20 days) for the Justice Minister and tax chief nominees.
- Nov 30 (after resolution): Han Duck-soo's first-instance sentencing in his separate case.
- Leading indicators before Nov 27: Realmeter's Nov 23 release (fieldwork Nov 16-20) and Nov 30 release, and NBS if it is published around Nov 26.

Sources: [Gallup report list](https://www.gallup.co.kr/gallupdb/report.asp), [MK 12209569](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/politics/12209569), [MK 12209360](https://www.mk.co.kr/news/politics/12209360), [Yonhap](https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20261116017851001), [Weekly Khan Nov 6](https://weekly.khan.co.kr/article/202611061020001), [Weekly Khan Sep 11](https://weekly.khan.co.kr/article/202609111016001), [Korea Times](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/politics/20261116/lee-approves-confirmation-hearing-requests-for-justice-minister-tax-agency-chief-nominees), [Donga](https://www.donga.com/news/Politics/article/all/20261115/135024716/2), [Herald 2025-11-14](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025111407000041984), [Herald 2025-11-27](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025112718084448298), [Imaeil 2022](https://www.imaeil.com/page/view/2022111811053579051), [Daum Feb 2026](https://v.daum.net/v/20260213111446622), [Segye NBS](https://www.segye.com/newsView/20260730507745)

## 1. Resolution source

The site is encoded in EUC-KR, so the titles came through garbled, but the issue numbers and dates read correctly. There is no data file behind the page, only an HTML list. - 2026-11-13: Report 682 (fieldwork Nov 10-12, n=1,002): approve 39%, disapprove 50%, undecided 10%. This comes from the question background. I could not find a news article confirming it. [Gallup Korea](https://www.gallup.co.kr/gallupdb/report.asp)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The fieldwork for the deciding report has not started.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: Lee approved sending his nominees for Justice Minister (Lee Yong-cheol) and National Tax Service chief (Ahn Duk-su) to confirmation hearings. Hearings must happen within 20 days. [Korea Times](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/politics/20261116/lee-approves-confirmation-hearing-requests-for-justice-minister-tax-agency-chief-nominees)
- 2026-11-16: Realmeter (for Asia Economy, Nov 9-13, n=2,512): approve 36.4% (+0.5), disapprove 60.9% (+0.3). Lee has been in the mid-to-high 30s on Realmeter since late August. ## 4. Base rates
- Gallup weekly approval, 2026 (from the background and press): Oct 13-15: 39, Oct 20-22: 40, Oct 27-29: 39 (disapproval 49), Nov 3-5: 41, Nov 10-12: 39. [koreancenter](https://www.koreancenter.or.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=1432275)
- That is a 39-41 range over five weeks, with moves of 1-2 points a week. A two-week horizon (Nov 12 to Nov 26 fieldwork) has historically been within ±3 points during flat periods. Sampling error alone is about ±3.1.
- The longer trend is down. On NBS, approval fell from a 69% peak in April to 55% in mid-July and 50% in late August. On Gallup it fell from about 60% in late 2025 to around 40%.
- Other trackers: NBS for the 5th week of October was 46/44, up from 44/49 in the 3rd week of October and 43/50 in the 1st week of October. That was the first time in two months approval beat disapproval. [Weekly Khan](https://weekly.khan.co.kr/article/202610291148001) Realmeter was 35.9 one week, then 36.4 the next.
- Seasonality: there is no meaningful seasonal pattern. For reference, in the same window in 2025 (his first year), Gallup went from 63 (Nov 1st week, after APEC) to 59 (2nd week) to 60 (3rd and 4th weeks). [Herald](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025111407000041984), [Herald](https://www.heraldk.com/article/2025112718084448298)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on Gallup Korea approval.
- Related markets: Polymarket's "Lee out as president in 2026" is at 2.6% Yes. Kalshi's "Lee serves full term" is at 58% Yes. Kalshi and Polymarket both put a 25bp Bank of Korea **hike** on Nov 25 at about 98-99%. Neither says anything direct about the approval number.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Nov 16-27: Budget Committee subcommittee markup of the roughly ₩820.9tn 2027 budget. Committee vote Nov 30, plenary deadline Dec 2.
- Nov 19: The Supreme Court's full bench hears Han Duck-soo's insurrection appeal. His detention expires Nov 20. There may be more controversy over Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, including talk of impeachment or a parliamentary investigation.
- Nov 24: Kim Min-seok's 100th day as Democratic leader. Merger talk with the Cho Kuk party.
- Nov 25: Bank of Korea rate decision. A hike is expected, which matters given that housing and the economy drive disapproval.
- Ongoing: The opposition is blocking the housing-supply bills, and confirmation hearings for the Justice Minister and tax chief nominees.
- Leading data before Nov 27: Realmeter's Nov 16-20 poll, out about Nov 23, and its Nov 23-27 poll. NBS seems to run every two weeks, which would put the next releases around Nov 12 and Nov 26, but I could not confirm the November NBS releases or their figures.
- Nov 30: Han Duck-soo's first-instance sentencing. This falls after resolution.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 11 days. Fieldwork runs November 24-26 and the report is released Friday, November 27, 2026 (KST).

(b) **Latest known value:** 39% approval in Gallup Korea report 제682호 (fieldwork November 10-12, released November 13, 2026). Disapproval was 50% and undecided 10%.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 39-40%. The last five readings average 39.6.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** essentially flat at 39-40.
- The long decline from about 63% in February has flattened into a 38-41% band since September.
- Realmeter is also flat in the mid-30s (36.4% for November 9-13).

(e) **Historical variation:** week-to-week moves have been 1-2 points. Over two weeks, a stable base plus sampling error (±3.1 points) usually gives a range of about ±3 points. Single controversies have occasionally moved the number 3-4 points within a week, as in November 2025.

(f) **Experts and markets:** no market or expert forecast exists for this number.
- Related markets show low political-crisis risk: Lee out as president in 2026 at about 2.6%, Lee arrested before 2027 at about 2.2%.
- A Bank of Korea rate hike on November 25 is near-certain. It could add marginally to the economy and housing discontent that drives disapproval.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** a new scandal or a public backlash over the Chief Justice impeachment or parliamentary investigation push, combined with the rate hike worsening housing sentiment. This could push approval to a new low of 34-35%.
- **High:** a diplomatic success, such as a summit with Xi, or a breakthrough on the housing bills, combined with favorable sampling noise. This could lift approval to 43-45%.

I centre the distribution on 39, with a slight downside tilt reflecting the earlier decline and the pending rate hike.

**(b) Latest known value:** 39%, from Gallup Korea 제682호 (fieldwork November 10 to 12, released November 13, 2026). Disapproval was 50% and undecided 10%.

**(c) If nothing changed:** About 39 to 40, the centre of the 39 to 41 band of the past five weeks.

**(d) If the current trend continued:** The trend is flat. Gallup has read 39 to 41 since mid-October, and the floor is about 38 (the September low). Realmeter is also flat at 35.9 to 36.4. The trend points to roughly 39.

**(e) Historical variation:** Week-to-week moves have been 1 to 2 points. Over two weeks on a stable base, sampling error alone (±3.1 at 95%) gives roughly ±3 points. In past Novembers, two-week moves were usually within ±2 to 4 points. A single controversy produced a 4-point drop in November 2025.

**(f) Experts and markets:** There is no market on this figure. Related markets (Lee leaving office or being arrested in 2026, both under 3%) imply no crisis. A Bank of Korea hike on November 25 is about 98% priced in, so it is not a surprise, but it could slightly reinforce housing and economic discontent during fieldwork. Realmeter's mid-30s readings sit about 3 points below Gallup and are consistent with Gallup holding near 39 to 40.

**(g) Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** A nominee scandal surfaces at the Justice Minister or tax chief hearings, Democratic infighting escalates over the Cho Kuk merger, and a housing-price spike follows the stalled supply bills. Approval could break below the 38 floor to around 34 to 35.
- **High:** A diplomatic win, such as a Xi meeting or summit news (diplomacy is the top approval reason), plus a housing bill deal with the opposition People Power Party. Approval could rebound to about 43 to 44.

The 1st percentile of 33 reflects a scandal-driven 6-point drop. The 99th percentile of 45 reflects a combined diplomatic and housing win.
